description: This header file defines internal API functions for the Slap Sco Gallery Object used within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component. It declares prototypes for functions related to state handling, collection management, management operations, and membership management within the gallery system.

methods.name: SlapScoGalGetSlapGoaIf
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP GOA interface handle associated with the object.

methods.name: SlapScoGalGetOlmContainer
methods.description: Gets the OLM container handle associated with the object.

methods.name: SlapScoGalGetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the gallery.

methods.name: SlapScoGalGetVariable
methods.description: Fetches a variable based on the provided parameter list.

methods.name: SlapScoGalSetVariable
methods.description: Sets a variable using the provided parameter list.

methods.name: SlapScoGalAddVariable
methods.description: Adds a new variable as specified in the parameter list.

methods.name: SlapScoGalDelVariable
methods.description: Deletes a variable specified in the parameter list.

methods.name: SlapScoGalDelAllVariables
methods.description: Deletes all variables from the gallery.

methods.name: SlapScoGalJoinGallery
methods.description: Adds the specified gallery variable to the gallery membership.

methods.name: SlapScoGalQuitGallery
methods.description: Removes the specified gallery variable from the gallery membership.
